message: Thanks! A few quick questions: (1) Roughly how much does your household earn from work in a year, before tax? (2) Is anyone pregnant, or is there a baby under 1? (3) Does anyone get health insurance through a job? (4) Does anyone have a disability?
reply: $202,200 a year. No, not us. I'm not sure. Nope.

summary: NH family of 4 (married, 2 kids) with about $202,200 earned income. This is well above the limits for SNAP, WIC, TANF, Medicaid, CHIP, EITC and school meals. It is above the 400% FPL cutoff for the ACA premium tax credit. Their tax liability exceeds the child tax credit, so no refundable part. No one is disabled, so SSI is out.
